_meta._note: Chapter 33 final test (ch33-test, new — not ch33-l06, which is now the An-Nas reading). Twelve multiple-choice questions on the 3/2/2/2/2/1 allocation: one per complete reading (Al-Falaq, An-Nasr, An-Nas), clause/connector (q04–05), the noun of إِنَّ and the predicate of لَيْسَ in simple governor-first sentences (q06–07, three options each — the words of the sentence), questions in context (q08–09), إِذَا and an expressed response (q10–11), a fresh passage decided from text evidence (q12). No imperfect paradigm. Pass mark 80 %: 9/12 fails, 10/12 passes. Rebuilt 2026-10-02 in the proposal harvest, batch 2 (Docs/proposals/proposal-harvest-tracker.md), from Docs/proposals/chapter-33-content-proposal.md and its review amendments: a Book 3 reading bridge — Al-Kafirun excerpts retrieved (Chapter 30 owns the full reading); complete, staged readings of Al-Falaq 113:1–5, An-Nasr 110:1–3 (110:2 included) and, new, An-Nas 114:1–6; a mixed lesson on what وَ joins, the noun of إِنَّ, the predicate of لَيْسَ, questions and إِذَا; the old capstone becomes the review; a 12-question readiness test. Unfamiliar Quran forms (أَعُوذُ، رَأَيْتَ، يَدْخُلُونَ، سَبِّحْ، اسْتَغْفِرْهُ، كَانَ، تَوَّابًا، يُوَسْوِسُ) are glossed whole. Removed: 'first complete surah' and 'every word' claims, Al-Fatiha 1:5 and the imperfect preview (Chapter 34), the 2:256 slogan inside Al-Kafirun, revelation chronology and the 'mission complete' inference, 'إِذَا always future/certain', كَانَ 'connecting to present sense', وَ as a sentence-boundary rule, الطَّالِبُ يَقْرَأُ called verbal, the wrong root of نَسْتَعِينُ, many-to-one matching boards, 'Parse:' true/false items and stray foreign words.

prompt.en: Why did Bilal go to the library?

questions.arabic: خَرَجَ بِلَالٌ مِنَ الْبَيْتِ وَذَهَبَ إِلَى الْمَكْتَبَةِ. إِنَّ الْمَكْتَبَةَ كَبِيرَةٌ، وَلَيْسَتْ بَعِيدَةً. سَأَلَهُ صَدِيقُهُ: لِمَاذَا أَنْتَ هُنَا؟ قَالَ: لِأَنَّ الِامْتِحَانَ غَدًا.

options.ur: کیونکہ اس کے دوست نے پوچھا
